verdict.rationale: Intuit maintains official SDKs (oauth-jsclient for Node.js, QuickBooks-V3-PHP-SDK for PHP) with documented OAuth flows, CRUD examples, and sandbox/production environment switches for safe development, plus an official MCP server exposing 145 tools across 29 entity types and 11 financial reports with write-safety toggles — directly enabling AI-native/agentic development against QuickBooks Online. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt (both probed 404), and no independent developer corroboration of SDK/MCP quality beyond first-party docs.
